citation.description: Ticket attestation: 'provenance: environment=operator macOS workstation, Codex CLI 0.150.0-alpha.8 against production https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp; principal=codex client PAT from SSM /rebar/prod/mcp-client-pat-codex; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — operator started a Codex session and confirmed the rebar MCP server loads'. LIVE VALIDATION comment confirms operator-confirmed working after credential fix.

criteria.criterion: [non-codebase] Given a fresh supported Codex desktop setup and a valid provisioned Codex PAT, when Codex launches, then the Rebar MCP server reaches ready state and a real read tool returns a structured result.

The canonical Codex PAT environment name is identical across the active setup path, committed examples, documentation, templates, and tests; stale alternate names are rejected or migrated with a clear message.
Given the PAT is missing from the GUI application environment, startup or a mandatory preflight fails clearly and names the missing variable plus the supported remediation, without printing the PAT.

citation.description: Ticket attestation: 'provenance: environment=production endpoint https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp; principal=a deliberately invalid bearer token; instrument=live-call — returned HTTP/2 401 with www-authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token"'. Phase 1 comment also confirms live probe result.

criteria.criterion: [non-codebase] Given an invalid PAT, the production endpoint remains fail-closed with HTTP 401 and the client surfaces an authentication error.
Automated regression coverage fails if the Codex config name and credential-delivery path drift apart again.
Bug 'Codex omits Rebar MCP at startup when the desktop PAT environment is missing or misnamed' is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces and expected behavior holds.
